name: Breathe XR
summary:
BreatheXR is an immersive application designed to help users practice mindful breathing in a series of soothing virtual environments.

In sessions both timed and untimed, users can choose from one of three classic inhale-hold-exhale-hold breathing rhythms (4-7-8, 4-4-4-4, and 3-1-6), which conform to established therapeutic breathing patterns.
Additionally, users can select a "Deep Inspiration Breath Hold" exercise, which trains users to hold their breath for upwards of 20 seconds at a time.
